An intimate 12-night pilgrimage through Egypt's most sacred sites. A ceremonial initiation. An embodied journey of purification, remembrance and regeneration.

The Call

We are naturally drawn to the mystery of the unseen that which beckons our spirit towards it. This calling to commune with the great unknown carries the wisdom of the ages to embody spirit into matter, to assist us in our journey of remembrance.

Kemet is calling us for initiation.

The teachings are embedded in the temples which activate our DNA. The messages are carried in the desert sands and in the life-giving waters of the Nile. There are keys in this place that transcend time and space opening the gates to the time crystal within us, awakening the god within.

We journey through the seven chakra temples from the lower Nile to the upper Nile initiating the purification of the 33 levels of consciousness and the activation of the Lotus of Life.

"In ancient Egypt, spiritual initiation was taken in the temples. Every temple reflects an aspect of the human being and contains a secret code. When unlocked, the initiate accesses transcendental information carefully guarded there. Egyptian gods and goddesses are our ancestors. They donated their DNA, their technology and their wisdom for the evolution of humanity."

We are being called to reactivate the healing technology of ancient Sound Temples through sound, prayer, and ritual at sacred Egyptian sites. This journey invites us to become living vessels of the Temple's frequency fields, calling us to devote our energy to become a sacred channel for personal and collective healing.

Come join us through the sacred temples of the Nile. To remember. To awaken. To activate. To anchor spirit into matter.

Your Guides & Facilitators
Raia of Earth
Blueprint Activation · Lotus Alchemist · Sacred Site Guide

Having travelled across 20+ countries grid working sacred sites from Hawaii to Egypt, Japan to Bali Raia has shared his work with thousands through retreats, ceremonies and activations worldwide. A conduit devoted to helping others remember who they truly are.

Mari-Isis
Priestess of the Isis-Mary Rose Lineage · Tantrika · Ceremonialist

Mari-Isis is creator of Red Rose Temple Mystery School, guiding sacred site pilgrimages, grid-work, and temple initiations throughout Egypt, France, and around the world. She is a tantrika, artist, priestess of the Isis-Mary Rose lineage, scholar of esoteric studies, ceremonialist, and teacher of divine union.

Janel Aurelia
Multidisciplinary Quantum Healer · Divine Feminine Codes

One body, many lives. Across a decade moving from East Timor to Singapore, Koh Phangan and now Bali, Janel walked a deep Feminine Awakening and Reclamation through the world's land portals. For seven years she has guided thousands of star souls and women into the full embodiment of their destiny.

Oliver Mathea
Wisdom Keeper · Sacred Site Guide · Teacher of Temple Consciousness

Oliver Mathea is a Wisdom Keeper, storyteller and international sacred site guide devoted to Temple Consciousness, exploring the architecture, geometry, sound and ritual of Ancient Egypt as living spiritual technologies. Immersed in Egypt's temples for over a decade, he guides others to experience the temples as living beings, and to become living temples themselves.

Sayed
Wisdom Keeper of the Giza Pyramid Plateau

Sayed's family has lived on the Giza Plateau for over 400 years, guardians of its sacred land. Raised among the pyramids, a profound vision beside the Pyramid of Menkaure at eighteen set his path. For four decades he has welcomed seekers as family, sharing the living spirit of Giza.

Yousef
Sacred Site Guide · Keeper of the Star Wisdom

After four years studying ancient Egyptian civilisation at university, Yousef was initiated into the living wisdom of his family lineage. He reads the temples and pyramids as sacred technology of the Isis mystery school aligned with the stars and constellations, woven along the Earth's energy lines and the stargates to other worlds.
